editorial:
Imagine a world where gas costs fifty bucks a gallon and everything is just plain crazy. You get thrown into a weird version of 1999 where a tired cop finds himself stuck in a deadly race across a wasteland. He ends up teaming up with a dangerous woman who is only interested in winning, and together they have to survive a road trip filled with mutants and psychos. The whole thing feels like a loud, colorful comic book that doesn't take itself seriously at all, making it a wild ride from the very first scene.

What really works here is the over-the-top action and the funny, campy energy. The acting is intentionally loud, and the pacing never slows down, though some of the CGI looks a bit cheap. If you love movies that are just pure chaos and gore, you will have a blast with this one.
endingExplained: After a series of crazy battles and crashes, the cop and his partner manage to survive the madness of the race. They face off against the remaining psychos in a final showdown that is filled with blood and explosions. In the end, they break free from the control of the race organizers. They manage to escape the dystopian nightmare, leaving the carnage behind as they drive off toward a hopeful, if still strange, future.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves grindhouse movies and crazy action.
